original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that installs Docker (apt or yum source), adds a specified user to the docker group, and ensures the docker daemon is running and enabled at boot.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs Docker (apt or yum source), adds a specified user to the docker group, and ensures the docker daemon is running and enabled at boot.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure Docker
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    docker_user: "{{ docker_user | default(ansible_user_id) }}"
    docker_edition: ce
    docker_packages:
      - "docker-{{ docker_edition }}"
      - "docker-{{ docker_edition }}-cli"
      - "containerd.io"
      - "docker-buildx-plugin"
      - "docker-compose-plugin"

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Ensure target user is defined
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - docker_user is defined
          - docker_user | length > 0
        fail_msg: "Variable 'docker_user' must be set (e.g., -e docker_user=ubuntu)."

    - name: Verify user exists on the host
      ansible.builtin.getent:
        database: passwd
        key: "{{ docker_user }}"

  tasks:
    # ---------- Debian / Ubuntu ----------
    - name: Install prerequisite packages (Debian family)
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - ca-certificates
          - curl
          - gnupg
          - lsb-release
          - apt-transport-https
        state: present
        update_cache: true
        cache_valid_time: 3600
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Ensure apt keyring directory exists (Debian family)
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/apt/keyrings
        state: directory
        mode: "0755"
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Add Docker GPG key (Debian family)
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "https://download.docker.com/linux/{{ ansible_distribution | lower }}/gpg"
        dest: /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
        mode: "0644"
        force: false
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Add Docker apt repository (Debian family)
      ansible.builtin.apt_repository:
        repo: >-
          deb [arch={{ ansible_architecture | replace('x86_64','amd64') | replace('aarch64','arm64') }}
          signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc]
          https://download.docker.com/linux/{{ ansible_distribution | lower }}
          {{ ansible_distribution_release }} stable
        state: present
        filename: docker
        update_cache: true
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Install Docker packages (Debian family)
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: "{{ docker_packages }}"
        state: present
        update_cache: true
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    # ---------- RHEL / CentOS / Rocky / Alma / Fedora ----------
    - name: Install prerequisite packages (RedHat family)
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name:
          - dnf-plugins-core
          - ca-certificates
          - curl
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Add Docker yum repository (RedHat family)
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "https://download.docker.com/linux/{{ 'fedora' if ansible_distribution == 'Fedora' else 'centos' }}/docker-ce.repo"
        dest: /etc/yum.repos.d/docker-ce.repo
        mode: "0644"
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Install Docker packages (RedHat family)
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name: "{{ docker_packages }}"
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    # ---------- Common configuration ----------
    - name: Ensure /etc/docker exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/docker
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Deploy secure Docker daemon configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/docker/daemon.json
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          {
            "log-driver": "json-file",
            "log-opts": {
              "max-size": "10m",
              "max-file": "3"
            },
            "live-restore": true,
            "userland-proxy": false,
            "no-new-privileges": true,
            "icc": false
          }
      notify: Restart docker

    - name: Ensure docker group exists
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: docker
        state: present

    - name: Add user to docker group
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ docker_user }}"
        groups: docker
        append: true

    - name: Ensure Docker service is enabled and running
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: docker
        state: started
        enabled: true
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Ensure containerd service is enabled and running
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: containerd
        state: started
        enabled: true

  handlers:
    - name: Restart docker
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: docker
        state: restarted
